name: io.github.lahma/bitbucket-mcp
description: Bitbucket Cloud pull requests over MCP: list, read, diff, comment, review, merge and decline.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_OAUTH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OAuth consumer key of your own Bitbucket Cloud OAuth consumer. Together with BITBUCKET_OAUTH_SECRET this enables the browser login flow.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bitbucket Cloud access token sent as a Bearer credential. Takes precedence over every other credential and skips the OAuth flow.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian account e-mail, used with BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN as Basic credentials.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian API token, used with BITBUCKET_EMAIL as Basic credentials.

environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Workspace slug used when a tool call omits the workspace argument.
